classification.reason: This query selects an untouched 2015-through-2019 alternate-reference lane. Before this configuration and implementation were frozen, only aggregate availability counts were requested; no row values, candidate scores, or holdout performance from this lane were retrieved.

source.query: select hostname,pl_name,disc_year,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,st_mass,st_masserr1,st_masserr2,pl_refname from ps where default_flag=0 and pl_pubdate>='2015-01-01' and pl_pubdate<'2020-01-01' and pl_orbper is not null and pl_orbpererr1 is not null and pl_orbpererr2 is not null and pl_orbsmax is not null and pl_orbsmaxerr1 is not null and pl_orbsmaxerr2 is not null and st_mass is not null and st_masserr1 is not null and st_masserr2 is not null order by hostname,pl_name,pl_refname
source.dependency_warning: The archive fields are real published catalog parameters, but some semi-major axes and masses are inferred or model-dependent. Alternate references for one object are not independent experiments.

evaluation.revision_reason: Version 1's 0.90 one-sigma minimum was not a statistically calibrated one-sigma criterion. Version 2 preregisters coverage floors around the Gaussian 0.6827/0.9545 references and adds a p90 standardized-residual cap. Version 1 remains REJECT and is never rescored.
